name: RU-28253
summary: RU-28253 is a non-selective serotonin receptor agonist of the tryptamine, 5-methoxytryptamine, and tetrahydropyridinylindole families. It is a tetrahydropyridylindole and a conformationally constrained analogue of 5-MeO-DMT.

pharmacology.text: RU-28253 is a non-selective serotonin receptor agonist of the tryptamine, 5-methoxytryptamine, and tetrahydropyridinylindole families. The drug shows high affinity for the serotonin 5-HT1A receptor (Ki = 5.7 nM) and lower affinity for the serotonin 5-HT2A receptor (Ki = 230 nM). Its affinities for these receptors were higher than those of dimethyltryptamine (DMT).

uses.en: It is used only in laboratory research and is not a medicine.
uses.zh: 它僅用於實驗室研究，並不是藥物。
uses.zhHans: 它仅用于实验室研究，并不是药物。

fact.en: Its RU code marks it as a compound from Roussel Uclaf, the French company best known for mifepristone, also called RU-486.
fact.zh: 它的 RU 代號表示這是法國 Roussel Uclaf 公司的化合物，該公司最知名的產品是米非司酮，也就是 RU-486。
fact.zhHans: 它的 RU 代号表示这是法国 Roussel Uclaf 公司的化合物，该公司最知名的产品是米非司酮，也就是 RU-486。
